name: Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo
description: The Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo is home to a richly diverse and decidedly unique population of animals for a small-town community zoo. With 118 species and 22 critically endangered species, every animal has a name and a backstory. The zoo is committed to education, conservation, adventure, and community engagement. Located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, the zoo offers daily keeper presentations, animal adventures, and premium animal experiences.
